text: Lactose itself comes from whey permeate: evaporated to 60-65 % solids and crystallised on cooling (Wikipedia: Lactose). Grade details are from supplier literature (Meggle), which is low authority.

sources.text: The table, the facts and the words on how it is made, from these.

steps.note: Whey permeate is concentrated by evaporation; this is how the lactose itself is made.

steps.name: crystallise
steps.note: The lactose crystallises as the concentrate cools, which also purifies it.
For the spray-dried grade, the crystals of alpha-lactose monohydrate are milled finely.
The milled lactose is suspended in water.
The suspension is spray-dried to spherical grains of crystalline lactose in a matrix of amorphous lactose.

sources.text: Wikipedia for lactose from whey permeate evaporated to 60-65 % solids and crystallised on cooling; a supplier's page for the spray-dried grade. The agglomerated and anhydrous grades are not drawn, for lack of an openable source.
